name: Bravado

parts.label: Innate
parts.text:
Innate: After casting an ability, Taric empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to each gain 100% total attack speed, deal 25 – 93 (based on level) (+ 15% bonus armor) bonus magic damage on-attack, and reduce the remaining cooldowns of his basic abilities by 1 / 1.09091 / 1.16667 / 1.23077 / 1.28571 / 1.33333 / 1.375 / 1.41176 / 1.44444 / 1.47368 / 1.5 / 2 (based on AH)
seconds.

name: Bastion

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Taric gains bonus armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by Bastion. While the tether persists, the ally also gains the bonus armor and Taric's abilities are mimicked to them, though the effects do not stack.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Taric gains bonus armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by Bastion.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Taric grants himself and the target allied champion a shield for 2.5 seconds, binding them with Bastion.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Taric grants himself and the target allied champion a shield for 2.5 seconds, binding them with Bastion.

parts.text: Taric can also self-cast to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

notes: The mimicked abilities will still complete even if Taric dies or leaves range.

Abilities are not mimicked to the bound ally if they are vanished via Alpha Strike, Hallucinate, Rappel, or Void Rush.
  - Mimicked abilities will also cancel if they vanish as above.
Bastion effects will be temporarily disabled while the bound ally is in a different realm than Taric (Death Realm). The tether will not break.
Bastion has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
